research_question: Can unchanged Debian 13 ARM64 systemd run as PID 1 and manage ordinary services on Kernal with reproducible Linux-compatible lifecycle semantics?
negative_controls: mandatory unsupported functionality must fail explicitly rather than fake success
no process-name or systemd-specific kernel special case is allowed
failed services must retain a diagnosable failure path

repetition_policy.timing_metrics: report distribution/variance and first-failure classification for every failed boot

promotion_rule.to_measured: unchanged systemd PID1 evidence must be tied to one exact tested commit and pinned rootfs/profile; no fake-success/process-name exceptions
promotion_rule.to_replicated: independent reproduction of the same pinned boot/service profile is required
